tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub las logs su bkod pa'i stangs stabs bsdus pa'i 'cham dpe 'phrin las bsam 'phel bzhugs// na mo gu ru badz+ra kī la ya/ bla ma mchog dang rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can bsrung mar bcas/ /gus pas btud nas dpal ldan phur pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod skabs kyi sa chog gi/ /phyag len bsdus pa'i phyogs la mos pa dag /dga' ba bskyed phyir de yi rnam gzhag rnams/ /rje btsun gong ma'i gsung bzhin 'dir spel lo/ /de yang thog mar bar chad kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir chas gos gyon zhing phyag mtshan bzung ba ni/ blos bzung ba man gyi cho ga phyag len song nas/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin las su rung zhing bsnyen bsgrub tshad du 'khyol ba'i gang zag yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa rnams phod kha/ rdo rje gong pa/ rus pa'i mgul rgyan/ se ral kha/ dgos pa rnams la skra tshab/ zhwa theb zhwa dar dang bcas pa/ 'byor na me long / bzung mo mchu thur/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs sogs kyis brgyan/ bla ma'i spur sol lam/ ma 'byor na ro sol mar dang bsres pa'i sna zhur 'then pa brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bkod pa mdzes pa'i bshad tshod dang mthun pa'i chos dang mi 'gal ba'i chos gos lus la gyon zhing / ban phur lag tu thogs/ gzhan snang shas mo 'phyor gyi chas snang ba la gang dran byas pa dang / snang shas nyon mongs kyis khog pa khengs kyang bgyid snyoms le lo dang / phangs sems dbang gis snang shas med mdog gi rgyan la chas bor byas na bla ma chos bsrung gi bka' chad yong nges pas/ snang shas dang lha mchod pa'i bsam pa ma nor ba rang gal che ba gzab 'tshal/ stangs stabs kyis bzung ba la/ gsol ba gdab pa/ bgegs bskrad pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa/ bka' bsgo 'dis tshig gdang dang bcas pa'i 'cham tshul ni/ hūm̐ nga'i nga'i zhes pa'i dus lag gnyis g.yas phyogs su dzam̐ 'dra ba byas la/

sa ba'i dus ldem gsig ngos rkang g.yas bteg la 'gro phyogs su phab/ lag g.yas gri skor 'dra ba bya ba sogs bsgral mchod kyi dam tshig chen po'i 'cham tshul dang 'dra ba shes par sla ba'i phyir 'dir ma bris so/ /rnams sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed bzhin byas la/ stangs stabs dngos la rol mo dang bcas pas rgyas par na rdo rje phur pa dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'cham yongs su rdzogs pa gnas de'am/ 'cham ra gzhan du'ang rung ste/ don snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du bsams nas byed pa yin pas so/ /bsdu na gar 'cham gyi tshul gzhan rnams dor te/ khro bcu'i stangs stabs tsam bya bar gsungs pa'i/ de'i tshul ni gong gsol btab kyi skabs su/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor bri ba'i dbus dang / gzhan rnams de'i mtha' la bskor nas bya dgos pa'i dpon slob rnams bzhugs tshul de dang 'dra ba'i ngang nas/ khro bcu rol pa'i stangs stabs dngos la/ rnga brdungs pa rnams lag gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing / dbyangs sogs cho ga mdzad pa tsam ma gtogs 'cham sogs mi dgos/ 'cham pa dpon slob tshang ma ban phur thogs shing / 'cham tshul ni dbyangs dang bstun nas bya ste/ oṃ 'au oṃ zhes pa'i dus bca' gzhi tsam las/ hūm̐ nga'i nan zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas bteg lag gnyis dpung steng du rgyang la/ chen na'i nan zhes pa'i skabs su lag stabs de ka'i ngang nas rkang g.yas mdun du phab cing lus cung zad nem/ de nas sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsring la/ ka ba'i nan zhes pa'i dus su lag stabs de kha'i ngang nas ma bteg pa la bskor/ rkang g.yon gyi rtse mo rgyab nas drud cing / zhal thams cad kyis rgyab phyogs phyir gzigs/ ra'i 'e 'e ya 'jog ces pa'i dus rkang pa gnyis thad sor bzhag lag gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi thad tsam du 'jog 'a'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus lus nem che ba dang sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsring zhing phyag nan gyi zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas bteg

lag gnyis gong bzhin rgyang la/ rgya 'a 'a zhes pa'i skabs rkang stabs gong bzhin g.yas phyogs mdun dngos su bskor la zhal thams cad kyis mdun phyogs gzigs ni 'e 'e ya 'jog ces pa'i skabs rkang pa gnyis thad sor bzhag lag gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi thad tsam 'jog ba'i ya'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus lus cung zad nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsring / lag nan gyi dus phur pa ban+dha la bskor/ gnyis ya'i dus phur pa nam mkha' la 'phyar/ thal 'a la'i zhes pa'i dus phur rtse ban nang du bcug lus cung zad nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsring ba ste yangs pa'i pad bskor dbus dang / sbyar 'a 'a ra 'jog ces pa'i dus g.yon phyogs su phur pa ban+dha la bskor/ 'a'i nan ya'i zhes pa'i dus phur rtse ban nang du bcug lus cung zad nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsring ba g.yon gyi pad bskor dang / gyen na'i dus yang g.yas phyogs su phur pa ban+dha la bskor/ du 'u 'u zhes pa'i dus phur pa nam mkhar 'phyar/ bsgrengs 'a 'a 'jog ces pa'i dus phur rtse ban nang du 'jug pa g.yas kyi pad bskor te pad bskor gsum mo/ /'a'i ya'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus lus cung zad nem zhing gsig rkang nan nga'i gnyis ya 'a 'a'i/ mthil 'e 'e le 'jog 'e 'e sbyar 'a 'a ra 'jog 'a'i ya'i thur ru du 'u 'u 'u zug 'u 'u ya 'jog ces dpa' bar la lag gnyis thal mo sbyar te dpral ba'i thad du gyen du bsgrengs/ rkang gnyis kyi mthil sa la sbyar nas rting pa gnyis sprad pa'i bar la sor bzhi lhag pa sogs gang thub byas nas gel ba'i 'dug steng gi pus mo gnyis phyir bskyed la/ lus cung zad nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsring / 'a'i ya'i ya'i dus lag stabs de ka las lus g.yon mdun du gcus shing gsig gnyis byed cing g.yon 'gying che bar mnan la/ tshig ge chen ne 'e 'e ces pa'i dus rkang g.yon rting bskor dang g.yas gseg tshig re dang bstun gnyis byas la g.yas su 'gying zhing lus nem la yang sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsring ste/

bzhi nan 'e 'e ya'i yang 'gugs 'a 'a nga 'jog ces pa'i dus lus dbus su thad kar blta zhing / lag gnyis de ka'i ngang nas rkang gnyis dgel ba'i tshul gyis nem/ yang sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrang la/ 'a'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus g.yon gong bzhin mdun du gcu zhing 'gying / bcag nan ga par ra 'a 'a zhes pa'i dus gong bzhin g.yas gsig gnyis dang 'gying ba 'dra/ bya 'gug 'a 'a ya 'jog ces pa'i dus lus thad kar bsring / oṃ mo badz+ra zhes pa'i dus dbus dang / kro 'o dha zhes pa'i dus g.yon dang / hūm̐ ngo ka ra zhes pa'i dus g.yas rnams su lag gnyis bskor zhing pad bskor gyi tshul bya/ hūm̐ gshed mnan zhes pa'i du g.yas zur rgyab tu gcus shing nem che ba dang / lag gnyis g.yas zur du brkyangs/ gardza gardza zhes pa'i dus g.yon sked gzer dang / rkang g.yas lag g.yas mdun nas bskor te bskor ba tshang ma gcig song ba dang / hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa'i dus lag g.yas ban+dha la bskor zhing g.yas phyogs la phur pa 'phyar/ g.yon thugs khar sdigs mdzub kyis ban+dha bzung g.yas 'gying che bar byas/ rkang g.yon phyogs bgrad nas rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo gyen la bteg rkang g.yas khro bo'i bzhugs stangs ltar sgyid pa ldem zhing pus mo phyir bskyed la rkang mgo sa la thad kar bzhag pa'o/ /'di man la 'dur gdangs dang bstun/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /zhes pa'i dus bca' gzhi tsam bya/ lag gnyis thugs khar bsnol byas nas/ /zhes pa dang tshig de dang mthun par thugs kar bsnol ba'i phyag rgya bcas nas tshig 'og ma gnyis ma rdzogs bar lus cung zad gsig cing sngags brjod dus pad bskor dang / rkang g.yas nang la bskor zhing g.yas 'gyings sogs gong bzhin/ phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams 'dra/ mtshams dang 'og gi khro bo la sngags brjod dus pad bskor dbus/ g.yas g.yon du byas/ bskor dus rkang g.yon nang la bskor/ lag g.yon 'phyar te g.yon 'gying byed/

gzhan 'dra/ stobs po che'i dbyangs kyi skabs/ lag rkang g.yas dang g.yon go brje/ g.yas bskor g.yon du bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs 'cham tshul gong hūm̐ ka ra dang 'dra/ khro bo byin gyi phyag rgya tshig dang bstun nas rnam rgyal bzhin byed pas go sla'o/ /'on kyang rta mgrin gyi/ lag gnyis spyi bor rgya bcings nas/ /zhes pa'i skabs su spyi bor mos la dpral pa'i thad lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa ltar byas la/ lus g.yas g.yon du gcu ba dang sgyid ldem bya/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skabs su/ sked pa brdungs pa bstan pa ni/ /zhes pa'i dus lag gnyis sked gzer ngos sked pa g.yas skyog g.yon skyog byed/ stobs po che'i skabs su/ steng nas gnon pa lta bu bya/ /zhes pa'i tshe ser mo'i rtse rnams bsnol te dpral ba nas rim pas gnon tshul gyis lte ba'i bar phab la sgyid ldem bya zhing gsig pa tsam mo/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsal byed rin po che'i do shal du/ steng dang phyogs kyi khro bo rnams/ /rkang g.yon drang bzhag g.yas nang bskor/ /'og dang mtshams kyi khro bo ni/ /g.yon pa nang du bskor bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /de nas bsrung ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po phur bu gdab pa ni/ cho ga dang dmigs pa zur 'debs bzhin yin la/ 'cham tshul slob dpon shar du blta bas lag g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang / g.yon hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa'i phur bu rnams rim pas bzung / gzhan rnams kyi g.yas ban+dha tho ba'i tshul dang / g.yon par rang gi phur bu bzung la khro bo bcur mos/ steng phyogs tshangs pa bsnol ba'i dbyangs slob dpon gyis byang drangs dpon slob thams cad gsung 'grig cing snyan pa yid 'khul bar bya/ de nas kī la ya gsum gyi bar la rdo rje'i 'gros dang bstun la bya ste/ de yang o 'o 'o oṃ/ zhes brjod dus lag pa g.yas g.yon la bskor nas dpung steng du 'phyar/ g.yon pa thugs khar sdigs mdzub bcas/

rkang g.yas rkang g.yon gyi thad nas bskor zhing g.yas thad du bzhag g.yon pa'i rting pa sa la btsugs rkang mo bteg te g.yon zur du bgrad/ mo zhes pa'i skabs su rkang g.yon cung zad bteg la g.yas 'gying shin tu che ba g.yon 'gro phyogs bzhag lus cung zad gsig cing sgyid pa bsring bad da'i dz+ra zhes pa'i skabs su rkang g.yas bteg cing / mdun nas bskor cing g.yon gyi rgyab zur du rdo rje'i g.yas ra 'bri tshul dang / rkang g.yon g.yas pa'i rting pa'i rgyab tu rtse sa la ma reg tsam du bteg tsam bya/ lag pa g.yon gyi phur mgo g.yas rnams tho ba bzung bar bsam la phur mgo brdungs tshul dang / ra'i dus sgyid pa bsring / kī'i 'e zhes pa'i skabs dang / li zhes pa'i dus rkang stabs lag stabs lus kyi rnam 'gyur rnams gong oṃ gyi dus dang khyad par med par bya/ kī la 'a 'a zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas g.yon gyi mdun zur du bzhag lag gnyis tho ba brdungs tshul sogs gong bzhin gyi g.yas rwa 'bri tshul byas nas lus nem zhing glo bur sgyid pa bsrang la/ yang nan 'a zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas/ rkang g.yon mdun nas bskor zhing g.yas zur du bzhag de bzhin lag gnyis cung zad bteg sked pa'i thad tsam du g.yas g.yon so sor bskor zhing / sked gzer byas la rkang g.yon rting pa btsugs/ rkang mgo bteg lus nem dang g.yas 'gying che zhing rting bskor ngos/ ro stod g.yas rgyab tu thog mar gcu/ de nas mdun dang g.yon rgyab phyogs su gcus la sgeg pa'i tshul bya ba'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon bteg cing lus cung zad gsig la g.yon zur bzhag /sar ra wa 'a 'a zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas g.yon zur gyi mdun la bskor rdo rje'i lte ba 'bri tshul byas la g.yas zur phab/ de mthun lag gnyis pa ya 'a zhes pa'i dus dang 'dra bar byas la sked gzer dang / big ge zhes pa'i dus lus nem zhing ro stod g.yas gcu g.yon gcu 'gying /

lus nem che ba sogs gong ya'i dus dang 'dra/ nan na'i zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon bteg la de khar phab ste lus nem gsig sgyid pa glo bur bsrang / ban na'i zhes pa'i dus lag stabs rkang stabs gong gi oṃ dang 'dra/ dha 'a 'a zhes pa'i skabs su rkang g.yon cung zad bteg la g.yon zur 'gro phyogs bzhag lus cung zad gsig cing sgyid pa bsrang / hūm̐ gi skabs su rkang g.yas bteg cing 'gro phyogs bzhag lag g.yas tho ba dang ban+dhas g.yon gyi phur mgo brdungs tshul bya zhing / nga'i dus kyang rkang g.yas bteg tsam byas phab la/ lus nem la cung zad gsig cing sgyid pa bsrang / phaṭ de'i ṭa zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon bteg la 'gro phyogs bzhag lag stabs sogs 'dra/ de lta bu'i 'cham tshul lan gsum song rjes rnga brdungs pa rnams kyis rnga phyir brdeg ngos chems brdungs dang gha ta'i sngags brjod/ slob dpon gyis hūm̐ mdzad steng du 'debs tshul byas shar lho'i g.yas sam/ shar gyi g.yas su phur gdan nam gang 'os su phyag len ltar btsugs/ rnam rgyal shar du 'debs tshul byas la shar ram/ shar lho'i dbus su gdab/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams de dang der 'debs tshul gong ltar byas la dbang phyug sngon shar lho 'am/ shar lho'i g.yon du gdab/ gshin rje lho'am/ lho nub kyi g.yas su gdab/ mi g.yo ba lho'am/ lho nub kyi g.yon du gdab/ rta mgrin nub bam nub byang gi g.yas su gdab/ gzhan gyis mi thub nub byang gi dbus sam g.yon du gdab/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa byang ngam/ byang shar gyi g.yas su gdab/ khams gsum rnam rgyal byang shar ram/ byang shar gyi g.yon du gdab/ stobs po che 'og tu 'debs tshul ngos nub byang gi g.yon du gdab pa'o/ /'dur gdangs rdzogs mtshams kyi rol mo dang 'cham tshul la/ thog ma'i 'theng brdungs gsum gyi dang po la lus g.yon phyogs gcu zhing lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi sta zur mtshams su g.yob/ lag g.yon g.yas kyi nu kha tsam du kha phub/

sgyid ldem che la lus sprug gsig gshegs shugs yod pa dang mgo gug bya/ 'theng brdungs gnyis pa la lus g.yas su gcu/ lag g.yas nam mkhar 'phyar/ lag g.yon lte ba'i thad du kha gyen la bstan/ lus sprug pa sogs 'dra/ 'theng brdungs gsum pa la lag gnyis g.yas zur du brkyang lus nem che zhing g.yas phyogs sprug gsig shed bskyed la/ de nas dgu brdeg la lag gnyis rol stabs kyi g.yas nas mdun la bskor/ bdun brgyad ces pa'i dus g.yas phyir bsdu zhing g.yon mdun la bskor lag gnyis pad skor byas la thugs khar mnyam pa dang / dgu zhes pa dang rnga che ba gcig gi dus lus nem che ba lag g.yas g.yas phyogs kyi nam mkhar 'phyar zhing sprug gsig shed che ba/ mjug tu 'theng brdungs gnyis gong dang 'dra/ de nas che ba gcig la lag gnyis so sor mdun du bzhag 'cham tshul 'di gong bka' bsgo dang gar 'cham rgyas pa byed na phur kha bsgyur ba sogs dgu brdungs bzlog pa'i rol mo lta bu gang la yang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /phur gdab rdzogs mtshams rol mo gsum brdeg lan bcas byas la rol mo rnams so sor bzhag srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ dpon slob thams cad kyis sgrub thabs ltar/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /zhes pa nas/ bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa me ri'i sngags kyi bar phyag rgya dbyangs dang bcas pa phyag len bzhin bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab gcig pu pa rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can nyid zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul bar rdo rje phur pa'i bsgrub mchod bgyis skabs gsar bu'i blo can rnams kyi don du 'khon rigs rig pa 'dzin pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /'di bskor gyi 'cham tshul rnams rdo rje phur pa'i bsgrub mchod gtong re bzhin kun la zob pa zhig yong gin 'dug pa de/

'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi dpe yongs rdzogs bzhugs che zhing shin tu dkon pa nas/ gar 'cham gyi slob dpon phal cher gyis ma mthong ba'i skyon du 'dug pas/ da phyin zur bkod kyi dpe nyung ngu 'di gar 'cham gyi slob dpon rnams kyis re re bshu bar mdzod/ 'di skor gyi 'cham tshul rnams slob ma rnams la nges par bslabs ste/ 'cham pa kun kyang tshul 'di la long ba 'khar 'dzugs kyi 'cham tshul mi dgos pa zhig mdzad 'tshal lo// //sarba maṅga lam̐// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ phur pa'i 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub las logs su bkod pa'i stangs stabs bsdus pa'i 'cham dpe/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
